_revision_note: v2 (galadriel, attempt 3, 2026-08-23). v1 of this file labelled three eor-test-2 framesets `Judgment (attribution MODERATE)` with `p3_role: style candidate — full status`. That label CONTRADICTED judgment/README-EMPTY.md in the same commit and is RETRACTED: Judgment was never positively identified in the L-16 fixtures, and the index note § 4.3 argues the circle-archetype event is most likely War Cry — a Soldier skill — which would make the name not merely unproven but wrong. v1 also indexed five framesets under eor-test-2/, which is git-ignored scratch and NOT in the repo. This file now describes only what is actually tracked.
_p3_consumer_warning: This supplement contains ZERO confirmed positive style candidates. Every tracked frameset is either a NEGATIVE style anchor (whirlwind) or an UNRESOLVED-identity candidate (circle). Do not train, calibrate, or exemplify positively on this set alone. The Codex dossier lane carries the positive load.

resolution_experiments: E-1 (~15 min): template-match the slot-3 hotbar icon against every node in the Soldier and Oathkeeper trees at eor-test-2 t~180-246 (both trees open and at rest). A match in the Soldier tree falsifies 'Judgment' outright and names the skill.
E-2 (owner, ~2 min): ask Matt directly whether Judgment is on the gd-eor-warlord bar and on which key. He built the character.

empty_by_decision.judgment/: Deliberately empty. See judgment/README-EMPTY.md. The circle-archetype candidate frames live in circle_candidate_unresolved/ under an UNRESOLVED- filename prefix. The plausible conclusion — flagged, not asserted — is that this build does not slot Judgment at all; EoR Warlords commonly run Eye of Reckoning + Vire's Might + Ascension + War Cry and skip it.
